item.title: Arizona weather forecast: Third winter storm set to hit the state
item.description: Two of three storms have passed our state. The third and final system is expected Thursday night.Following between 3–7" of snow that fell over parts of the Flagstaff area, another dose of 4-8" will be possible. The next area of low pressure and associated cold front will approach from the West tonight.By late afternoon/early evening, a few showers will start to move into northwestern Arizona.
